KnightLoader fixes what a code review of its newest features turned up: a crash from a forged Usenet article, downloads that went on after a pause or removal, and several security gaps. Every change is listed in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Signing out ends every copy of the session cookie.** A copy taken before the sign-out worked again once its last character was changed.
- **Play links end with the token that asked for them,** and when you change the password or sign out everywhere. They used to work for up to twelve hours.
- **No other website can load the quick-add page inside its own.** On an instance without a password, a hidden button on another site could press Add for you.
- **Limits on what the instance reads into memory.** A body sent with an API token stops at 16 MiB, and a file asked for through the group is refused instead of loaded whole.
- **A forged Usenet article can no longer crash KnightLoader** or grow the download's file to whatever size it names. The same goes for a server that never ends an article or a reply line.
- **An `.nzb` that leaves out articles no longer finishes with a hole.** It is no longer reported to Sonarr and Radarr as completed; the missing articles go to your next account, or the file fails with the reason.
- **A download paused or removed just as it starts stays stopped.** It no longer finishes in the background, and nothing is copied into the temp folder.
- **Restarting a download no longer deletes another download's file** that landed at the same path after you deleted the first one by hand.
- Undo brings back a download that was being unpacked as finished, and a finished or failed one no longer blocks its link or misses its retry.
- On Windows, pausing a live recording stops ffmpeg as well.
- A paused download whose package was renamed carries on after a restart instead of starting over.
- Several sources for one file leave out a debrid account that allows fewer connections for the hoster.
- Large Usenet downloads show the right progress after a restart.
- The browser extension keeps one card on the Instances page, and removing that card takes the browser out of the group.
- The JDownloader import leaves Packagizer rules unticked whose folder exists only on JDownloader's machine, and counts rejected links apart.
- Feed entries and the files on a crawled page can no longer point a download into the local network.
- The Android app asks about battery optimisation and notifications only once, takes a captcha notification down when it stops watching, opens the QR scanner when you come back with the camera allowed, and keeps the relay a scanned code names for Connect.

## 🌐 Translations

- Every new text is in all 42 languages.
